styleFacts: The page reuses .hotkey-panel, .hotkey-grid and .hotkey-card styling from the exact common stylesheet.
.hotkey-grid uses two equal columns with 10px gap at normal width and one column responsively.
.hotkey-card uses a 1px card border, card surface/shadow, 8px radius, 12px 14px padding and 8px internal gap.
.mini-game-actions is an aligned flex row with 8px gap; its buttons have minimum width 120px.
.hotkey-state uses caption size and weight 650; enabled state uses success text.
